entities.name: porter with a bundle on a shoulder pole
entities.what: Man in a short pale jacket with an apron-like wrap to the knees, bare lower legs and a pointed cap or knotted kerchief, walking east across the open ground west of the wheelwright's; a carrying pole rests on his right shoulder and slants down behind him to the west, where a dark bundle or sack hangs from its end; his free hand is raised in front of his chest. A porter or traveller.
entities.note: Feet at (13518, 688) and (13555, 687). Pole from about (13470, 595) through his shoulder (13530, 560) to its front tip (13550, 540); the bundle hangs at u 13475-13500, v 580-625. Painted height 155 px at foot v 688, the tallest figure in this tile (the muleteer up the street is 99 px at v 493). The restyle draws the same man. t2 looks this far east and may record him too: keep one.

entities.name: man walking by the pack mules (muleteer?)
entities.what: Man in a pale short jacket and trousers with a dark cap, walking on the street at the top of the silk just south-west of the lowered head of the front pack mule; his arms are folded at his chest round something small (a bundle, or a whip's handle); head turned west. Probably the mules' driver.
entities.note: Feet at (13546, 492) and (13574, 492). Painted height 99 px at foot v 493. He stands about 20 px west and 70 px south of mule S4b.ani.mule_pack_head_down_13612's lowered head (13583, 420). The restyle draws the same man holding a bundle in both arms. Which way he walks is not clear from the legs; the head turns west.

entities.name: wheelwright bending over the lying wheel
entities.what: Workman in a short jacket and trousers, hair in a topknot, bending forward from the waist over the big cart wheel lying on the ground (S4b.prop.loose_wheel_13665): his head is at the west end and his back toward the east; his west arm reaches down to the wheel's west rim, where he holds a mallet or a block (or grips the rim). The wheelwright at work (车铺劳作).
entities.src: 余辉: 车铺劳作; 名画记: 大车修理店 (pin 26); 张安治: first crossroads
entities.note: Head 13571-13599, v 641-665; one continuous outline runs from the head over the shoulders to the back's east end at about (13660, 680); legs at u 13598-13645 down to v 752-758; the arm (or a tool's handle) runs down at u 13575-13592 to a dark knob at (13565-13588, 750-763) on the rim's west end. The restyle splits him into two men (a standing man in blue at the head end and a man in beige bending with his back up); the strokes show one outline, so one man (the setup agent read it so too). Bent height 114 px; standing he would be about 150 px, like the porter.

entities.name: man in a wide dark hat behind the wheel
entities.what: Man in a wide, flat dark hat and a long pale robe standing behind (north of) the east end of the lying wheel among the wheelwright's timbers, face turned south-west toward the bending wheelwright; his lower body is hidden behind long leaning timbers. Perhaps the wheel's owner or a second craftsman.
entities.vis: part: lower body behind leaning timbers (S4b.prop.leaning_poles_13775)
entities.src: 余辉: 车铺劳作; 名画记: 大车修理店 (pin 26); 张安治: first crossroads
entities.note: Hat as a dark band at u 13711-13774, v 637-654 (63 px wide, a broad brim); a face below it at about (13743-13757, 657-677); robe lines down to about v 740-760. Reading two: the dark band is the top of a trestle or workbench and the shape under it is goods, with no man (the setup agent called this 'a blocky object and one or two figures'). The restyle paints a man in white with a black hat here, and a saddled mule west of him (the mule is invented: see S4b.prop.striped_load_13684). Foot estimated from a standing height of about 150 px (the porter's at v 688); the wheel's east rim ends at (13752, 784).

entities.name: man standing behind the big tree on the top street
entities.what: Man in a pale robe and a dark cap standing on the street at the top of the silk just east of the pack mules, behind the west stem of the big two-stemmed tree; he looks down and to the west toward the mules. His lower body is hidden by the tree's fork and the wheelwright's shed roof.
entities.vis: part: crossed by the tree's stem and twigs; feet behind the shed roof
entities.note: Face at 13837-13857, v 267-290; robe 13830-13877 down to about v 357, where the tree's fork and the upper end of the shed roof hide him. Foot estimated from a height of about 100 px (the muleteer's at v 493 is 99 px). The restyle draws one man here, in white with a cap. At zoom 1 a second head seemed to show at u 13860-13878, v 285-300; at zoom 3 it is his sleeve. In the mules' group as a possible second drover (he stands 40 px east of the third mule's rump and looks at the mules): a reading, not painted fact.

entities.name: bearded man looking up, behind the latticed roof south of the road
entities.what: Bearded man with a dark cap or topknot and a pale robe standing on the south side of the road, head tilted back, looking up and to the east; only his head and shoulders show above the latticed roof of the south row.
entities.vis: part: below the chest behind the latticed roof (u 13650-13900, v 1200-1300)
entities.note: Head 13730-13770, v 1158-1195 (beard at 13760-13775, v 1180-1200); body down to about v 1250, where the roof's lattice and ridge hide it. He stands north of the south row's roof, so on the road (support ground). Foot estimated at v 1315 from a standing height of about 155 px (the porter's 155 px at v 688; the road's figures are no smaller). The restyle draws the same man.

entities.name: man with a cap behind the small dark donkey
entities.what: Man with a dark cap and a pale jacket standing behind (north of) the small dark donkey at the east end of the saddled-horse group, face turned east; one arm reaches west toward the men at the horse. Only his head and shoulders show above the donkey.
entities.vis: part: body hidden by the donkey
entities.note: Head 13497-13527, v 956-987; arm toward (13473, 987). Member of t2's horse-and-donkeys group (u 13300-13560): t2 owns the group and the small dark donkey (its legs at u 13480-13563 reach v 1103-1120; its head end is hidden at the west, so its fore is at about (13490, 1108)). The restyle turns the donkey into a man in blue bending over, and draws this man bald. Foot estimated just north of the donkey's hooves. On the t2|t3 boundary: if t2 records him too, keep one.

entities.name: man bending forward holding a sack
entities.what: Working man in a short jacket over a long pleated wrap, bending forward at the east end of the saddled-horse group with his head down toward the west; he holds a pale sack or cloth bag open in front of him with both hands.
entities.note: Head 13550-13577, v 968-1000; bent back to about u 13637; legs 13590-13617 down to v 1087-1093. The pale hanging shape at 13557-13587, v 1030-1087 is the sack (or the front of his robe held up). The restyle draws him with a striped skirt holding a big white sack open, and adds a man in blue bending opposite him at 13500-13560 where the scan has the small dark donkey. He belongs to t2's horse-and-donkeys group (his `group` is for the merge to set).

entities.name: stall keeper seated behind the goods table (faint)
entities.what: A faint figure seated behind the table of goods under the east end of the wheelwright's shed roof, head and shoulders above the heaped goods; dress unreadable. Probably the stall keeper.
entities.note: Outline at u 13913-13964, v 833-884 between the goods heap and the shed post at u 13960; the restyle draws a man in brown seated cross-legged here. Reading two: the outline is more goods piled on the table. Feet estimated just behind the table's back legs (about v 940).

entities.name: faint figure behind a rail west of the big tree's trunk
entities.what: A small, faint head-and-shoulders shape behind a horizontal rail between the shed's east post and the big tree's trunk: perhaps a person inside the open front of the shed or of the tea house's west end.
entities.note: Curved strokes at u 13985-14005, v 882-915 above a rail at v 932-942; the ground below the rail (v 942-1000) is bare, so if it is a person it stands or sits behind the rail. The restyle draws a small face and hands here. Reading two: fittings of the rail or the stall, no person. Its building is the structures agents' (shed: structures_w; tea house: structures_e).

entities.name: pack mule with its head down (front)
entities.what: Mule (long-eared; a donkey is possible) carrying a pack saddle heaped with a dark hatched load (sacks or bundles under a cloth), standing on the street at the top of the silk with its head lowered to the west near the muleteer; the nearest of the pack animals.
entities.note: Body and load u 13590-13700, v 330-405; four hooves at about (13600, 450), (13612, 458), (13650, 448), (13685, 437). Nose to rump about 125 px at foot v 450, where the muleteer is 99 px tall: a mule or a small horse rather than a donkey. The restyle draws a grey-blue mule with a blue pack cloth.

entities.name: pack mule with its head raised (behind the first)
entities.what: Second pack mule, behind (north of) the first, its head raised and ears up at the west end, a dark hatched load on its pack saddle; its legs are hidden by the first mule.
entities.vis: part: legs behind the first mule
entities.note: Head with two upright ears at u 13618-13645, v 328-350; body and load 13636-13714, v 294-350; one hind leg shows at 13705-13714 down to about v 422. The fore hooves are estimated behind the first mule's body. The restyle draws a brown mule with a raised head here.

entities.name: pack mule under the big tree's branches
entities.what: Third pack mule, east of the other two and under the big tree's twigs, head and neck lowered to the west, a dark hatched pack load on its back.
entities.vis: part: crossed by the tree's twigs
entities.note: Head and neck down at 13710-13736, v 357-398; body and load 13736-13818, v 325-380; hooves at (13750, 427) (a dark hoof blob), (13773, 413), (13808, 392) and (13817, 410) (the one at 13808 may be the fourth mule's).

entities.name: possible fourth pack mule (hidden)
entities.what: A possible fourth pack mule behind (north of) the third, mostly hidden by it and by the big tree's west stem; one leg and part of a pack load show.
entities.vis: part: behind the third mule and the tree's stem
entities.note: Evidence: a fifth leg at (13787, 397) among the third mule's four, and a second hatched load at u 13773-13818, v 307-357 above the third's. The restyle paints a fourth mule here with a brown pack and a raised head at about (13792, 315). Reading two: three mules only, the extra leg and load being the third mule's tail and harness and the tree's knots. Changes the cast: keep it low until the second pass settles it.

entities.name: big bare two-stemmed tree
entities.what: Big bare deciduous tree (elm-like: gnarled bark with knot holes, crooked twigs tipped with buds, no leaves) whose thick trunk stands at the west end of the tea house and forks low into two stems: the west stem leans far north-west over the wheelwright's shed to the top street, its crown spreading over the pack mules; the east stem rises over the big roof east of the shed.
entities.vis: part: lower trunk behind the goods stall and the tea house's front
entities.note: Root base u 13985-14100 at v 1065-1100 (base point = its middle); the stems part at about v 1000: west stem 14000-14050 at v 900, then through (13960, 650), (13880, 400), (13800, 250); east stem 14060-14130 at v 900 (knot hole at (14110, 980)), then through (14090, 650), (14180, 450), (14270, 230). One tree, two stems from one root base (the stems' feet merge within 60 px). Crown top at about (13720, 140), at the top-street shop's eave; crown_e from its twigs over the big roof at about (14415, 640), in t4's range. The restyle draws the same forked trunk. The whip-crowned willow-like tree at u 14100-14450, v 80-270 is another tree (t4's).

entities.name: big cart wheel lying flat (the wheelwright's)
entities.what: A big spoked cart wheel lying flat on the ground in front of the wheelwright's shed, its hub standing up from the spokes; the wheelwright bends over its west rim. Under repair (车铺劳作).
entities.vis: part: east rim among the timbers
entities.src: 余辉: 车铺劳作; 名画记: 大车修理店 (pin 26); 张安治: first crossroads
entities.note: SCALE CUE: outer rim u 13574-13752 (178 px across), v 761-799 (38 px); inner rim u 13591-13742, v 765-791; hub at about (13665, 768). base = the rim ellipse's centre on the ground. DEPTH CUE: the ellipse's minor axis is 0.21 of its major (38/178) and its major axis is almost level (west tip (13574, 776), east tip (13752, 784), dv/du +0.045). Painted diameter 178 px against the bending wheelwright (about 150 px standing): about 1.2 of a painted man's height, a big cart wheel. The spokes are too fine to count on the scan. The restyle draws the same wheel.

entities.name: tall pole frame with a hanging basket
entities.what: Free-standing tall frame of bent poles tied together at the top like a hooped arch, with a big round woven basket hung inside it on short cords at about mid-height; it stands just north of the lying wheel, west of the wheelwright's shed.
entities.vis: part: feet hidden behind the bending wheelwright and the striped load
entities.src: 余辉: 车铺劳作; 名画记: 大车修理店 (pin 26); 张安治: first crossroads
entities.note: Top knot at (13694, 494); the poles splay to a west hoop at about u 13628 (v 640) and east legs at u 13720-13735; a middle pole runs down at u 13690-13694 to about v 740. Basket rim u 13654-13738, v 574-590, its bottom at v 612. The feet are hidden at about v 740-750 (base = their middle, est). Height above the feet about 254 px. What it is for is not painted (a shop sign, a drying rack or a lifting frame). The restyle draws the same frame and basket.

entities.name: striped load on low legs by the wheel
entities.what: A rounded mass with close horizontal stripes (a woven basket, a bundle of spokes or felloes, or a mat-wrapped load) on low legs or a trestle, between the bending wheelwright and the man in the wide hat, just north of the wheel.
entities.vis: part: behind the bending wheelwright's back
entities.src: 余辉: 车铺劳作; 名画记: 大车修理店 (pin 26); 张安治: first crossroads
entities.note: Mass u 13654-13714, v 648-704; vertical strokes under it at u 13691-13706 down to about v 740 may be its stand's legs or the pole frame's middle legs. The restyle paints a saddled mule here (a brown saddle on a mule whose head is down at about (13700-13720, 700-740)). That body would be only 60-70 px long, against 125 px for the pack mules at v 450 (nearer animals paint larger), so it is not an animal; the setup agent called it 'a blocky object'. Reading two: a second workman bending with his back to the viewer (no head shows).

entities.name: long poles or shafts leaning by the shed
entities.what: Two or three long poles or cart shafts leaning diagonally from the ground beside the wheel's east end up toward the wheelwright's shed eave, in front of the man in the wide hat.
entities.vis: part: tangled with the timbers and the hat man's robe
entities.src: 余辉: 车铺劳作; 名画记: 大车修理店 (pin 26); 张安治: first crossroads
entities.note: Long curved parallel strokes from about (13715, 690) down to (13800, 770), parallel to the shed roof's west edge. Reading two: the shed's own posts or rafter ends (structures_w). The restyle draws a long brown board leaning here.

entities.name: tool lying on the ground by the wheel
entities.what: A small tool (a chisel, or a short adze or axe on a handle) lying on the ground just south of the wheel, pointed end to the west.
entities.src: 余辉: 车铺劳作; 名画记: 大车修理店 (pin 26); 张安治: first crossroads
entities.note: Stroke from (13620, 820) to (13650, 812), about 30 px long. The restyle draws a hammer-like tool with a red handle here.

entities.name: timber pile at the wheelwright's
entities.what: A low pile of squared timbers and poles lying crosswise on the ground south of the lying wheel, some with notched or rounded ends (cart shafts, axles, felloe blanks?): the wheelwright's stock.
entities.vis: part: east end under the shed's eave
entities.src: 余辉: 车铺劳作; 名画记: 大车修理店 (pin 26); 张安治: first crossroads
entities.note: Extent u 13648-13840, v 803-878; the timbers run from lower left to upper right (e.g. (13660, 870) -> (13760, 805), dv/du -0.65: lying at random, not a receding edge). Rounded cut ends at the west end (u 13650-13670, v 838-870). The restyle draws the same pile.

entities.name: table of goods under the shed's east end
entities.what: A long table at the south-east end of the wheelwright's shed, under its eave, heaped with goods (S4b.prop.goods_heap_13925); a big round shallow basket stands at its west end and sacks or baskets lie under it. A small stall.
entities.vis: part: back hidden by the goods
entities.note: Top u 13800-13970 at v 907-920; front legs' feet at (13858, 983) and (13927, 983), a west leg at (13807, 946). SCALE CUE: table height about 63-67 px (top v 920 to feet v 983-987). The restyle draws a table of goods with baskets and hanging bags.

entities.name: big round shallow basket at the goods table
entities.what: A big round shallow basket (a sieve or winnowing tray?) about 80 px across, at the west end of the goods table, on a low stand of its own or on the table's end.
entities.note: Rim u 13801-13884, v 866-897, bottom at about v 920; one stand leg at (13807, 946). The restyle paints a large woven basket here.

entities.name: goods heaped on the table
entities.what: Goods heaped on the stall's table: rounded bundles, jars or bowls (not readable one by one).
entities.note: Heap u 13880-13967, v 853-907 (the setup agent's 'dark mass east of the wheel'). The restyle draws baskets, bowls and bundles.

entities.name: sacks or baskets under the goods table
entities.what: Rounded sacks or baskets on the ground under the goods table.
entities.note: Curved shapes at u 13830-13947, v 920-970 between the table's legs. The restyle draws two woven bags hanging under the table.

entities.name: long table in the top-street shop
entities.what: Long table standing in the open shop on the north side of the top street, behind the pack mules.
entities.note: Top u 13570-13657, v 227-257; front legs at u 13573 and 13627 to about v 290, back legs to about v 277. SCALE CUE: 87 px long at foot v 285. The restyle draws the same table with two benches.

entities.note: Top u 13570-13613, v 283-293; legs at u 13573 and 13607 down to about v 327.

entities.name: bench or low table further east in the top-street shop

entities.vis: part: crossed by the tree's twigs
entities.note: Top u 13700-13760, v 225-240; legs at about (13737, 262) and (13757, 260); a slanted piece at u 13703-13727, v 227-247 (a chair back?). The restyle draws a bench and a slanted lounging chair.

entities.name: table in the far top shop (west)
entities.what: Table in the open shop at the top of the silk north of the wheelwright's shed, with a bench on either side in front.
entities.note: Top u 13930-14010, v 95-120; legs to about v 130-140. Faint and small (far up the silk). The restyle draws the same table.

entities.what: Bench in front of the west table of the far top shop.

entities.name: bench in the far top shop (front east)

entities.name: lattice-backed seat at the far top shop's back
entities.what: A seat with a lattice back (or the shop's rear railing) behind the west table of the far top shop.
entities.note: Lattice u 13957-14002, v 70-95. Reading two: the shop's rear railing (structures). The restyle draws a lattice partition.

entities.name: chair with a round back in the far top shop
entities.what: A chair with a rounded back between the two tables of the far top shop.
entities.note: u 14017-14040, v 80-125. The restyle draws a chair with a round disc on its back.

entities.what: A stool beside the east table of the far top shop.

entities.name: tall reed mat at the far top shop's west end
entities.what: A tall reed mat or mat screen, vertically hatched, hanging from or leaning against the eave at the west end of the far top shop and reaching nearly to the ground.
entities.vis: part: its top merges with the roof's hatching
entities.note: Hatched wedge from about (13830-13850, 40) down to u 13840-13895 at v 175-182, below the eave line (v 76-130). Reading two: part of the building (a mat hung from its eave, structures_w) or the hatched end of the west roof. Recorded as a prop by the brief's rule (a duplicate is easy to drop). The restyle draws a leaning reed mat.

entities.name: the wheelwright's yard (车铺劳作)
entities.what: A wheelwright repairs a big cart wheel lying flat on the ground before his shed: he bends over its west rim with a mallet; a man in a wide dark hat watches from behind it; a hooped pole frame with a hanging basket, a striped load on low legs, long poles leaning toward the shed, a tool on the ground and a pile of timber make up the yard.
entities.src: 余辉: 车铺劳作; 名画记: 大车修理店 (pin 26); 张安治: first crossroads
entities.note: The shed itself is structures_w's (its tiled roof runs diagonally from about (13726, 463) to (13865, 840), with a small pent-roofed lattice box under its west end at u 13730-13763, v 587-637).

entities.name: pack mules on the top street
entities.what: Three (perhaps four) pack mules with dark hatched loads on their pack saddles stand facing west on the street at the top of the silk, heads down or raised; a man walks at the front mule's head (the muleteer), and another man watches them from behind the big tree.
entities.note: On 张安治's first crossroads, if the top street is its north arm (structures_w maps the street).

entities.name: goods stall under the wheelwright's shed
entities.what: A small stall at the south-east end of the wheelwright's shed: a table heaped with goods, a big round shallow basket at its west end, sacks under it, and a faint seated keeper behind.
entities.note: The restyle invents sacks and bundles here; the strokes show the table, the basket and a dark heap.

entities.name: willow (head and whips only) over the big elm's fork
entities.what: Willow whose fine bare whips radiate upward from a knob above the big two-stemmed elm's fork, fanning over the big roof behind the trees; its trunk is unseen. Bare, early spring.
entities.vis: part: only the head (knob and whips); the trunk is hidden behind the big elm's east stem and the tea house's roof
entities.note: Added in the merge: t4 saw a third willow fan converging at about (14090, 390) (u 14010-14200, v 250-480) and left it to t3 by its u; t3 did not record it. On the merge agent's crop (scratchpad S4b_merge/c_fan.jpg, zoom 2) the knob is at about (14080-14095, 380-395) and fine straight whips fan up to v ~250 over u 14010-14200, unlike S4b.tree.forked_elm_14045's crooked, dark, budded twigs. Base est on the ground behind the tea house's back roof (v ~700, as t4 placed S4b.tree.willow_head_14300 and _14470); it could be anywhere at v 600-1000 behind the elm's east stem and the tea house's roof. Other reading: the upper whips of S4b.tree.willow_head_14300 (its knob is 215 px east and 100 px higher). The restyle paints a hipped tiled roof here, with the whips as twigs.
